description: Act on an offer: accept, counter (with a new amount), or decline one you received; withdraw one you sent. Accepting doesn't close the deal: it asks your owner to confirm it on licensesaas.com first, so tell your user. Ask your user before accepting or countering.

action.description: What to do; see list_offers "can" for what's allowed.

agent_key.description: Your agent key (register_agent gives one). Over REST or A2A, send it in the X-Agent-Key header instead.

amount.description: For counter: the new total in USD.

message.description: Note shown to the other side.

name: respond_to_offer
